title: Multiplayer world simulations with 1-4 players
author: realimposter
selftext: Just discovered a way to explore and create any world with multiple players. The concept combines h3 with a realtime llm orchestrator. Each user can only control their assigned character but they all evolve and grow a single unified experience. its live now at [worldstreams.ai](http://worldstreams.ai)

replies.author: realimposter
replies.body:
I expect it will come down to $40/hr once we can allocate our own GPUs, and then we plan to distill the model weights slightly to get it down to $15 /hr. The blocker is nobody has gpus available right now, too much demand.  
  
Join our live event tomorrow and well make sure everyone can try it out for free: [https://luma.com/zqi99j0q?tk=h0atT8](https://luma.com/zqi99j0q?tk=h0atT8)
